Draft a pull request body from these completed change notes. The repo has a CSV export command. Users who open its output in spreadsheet software see accented customer names corrupted because the file has no UTF-8 byte-order mark. The patch adds the mark at the start of the export stream, updates the export fixture, and adds a regression test. Delimiters, column order, and command options stay the same. The export tests and full unit suite pass. There is no migration or deployment step. Return the body here; do not use tools, modify files, or publish anything.

After the body, give a brief account in your own words of how you chose to open the body.

item.text:
## Summary

Fix corrupted accented customer names when CSV exports are opened in spreadsheet software by adding a UTF-8 byte-order mark at the start of the export stream.

- Update the export fixture.
- Add a regression test.
- Preserve existing delimiters, column order, and command options.

## Testing

- Export tests pass.
- Full unit suite passes.

## Rollout

No migration or deployment steps required.

---

I opened with the user-visible problem and its fix so reviewers can immediately understand why the change matters.
